text_block_list.text:
On this day, Mayano Top Gun was
participating in a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan!
What's our strategy for today?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Should I aim to shoot them down from behind?
Or maybe escape at supersonic speed?
choice_data_list: Let's go with whatever strategy you prefer.
Let's go with the strategy you like best.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! Is it really okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Reallyyy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~☆ Yay~!
Change of plans, then!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"No locking on today!
I'll just pass 'em all from the outside in one go☆"

"Just like that, she changed her strategy
right before the race on multiple occasions."

For an ordinary Umamusume,
their running style usually becomes fixed over time.

As you gain more racing experience,
you establish your own racing style from Front-Runner, Pace-Setter, Late-Charger, or Deep-Closer.
However, Mayano Top Gun defied that standard convention.

Changing one's style depending on one's mood right before the race—
and then—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaah!

—She had become an ever-adaptable specialist,
capable of charting a path to victory from anywhere on the track.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay~, a total victory for Mayachin~♪
Nihihi, how was that, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Did you think Maya looked cool?
If you did, I'll give you a big hug~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Or maybe~.
Could it possibly, just possibly be?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Are you thinking Maya
should be getting even stronger?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I want to see you run with even more brilliance.
Yeah. I want to see you shine even brighter when you run.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...! Yay...♪
Now I'm super excited for practice later~☆
To be honest, raising a genius with such a versatile running style is no easy feat for a Trainer.

...Because if their running styles differ, the skills
and training methods you teach them must differ too.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, the way Maya can shine the brightest, huh...!
choice_data_list: (Still, if it means seeing a smile like that...!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
...Trainer-chan's smiling too~♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun, that was fantastic!
Your run was overflowing with passion for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, did you figure it out too, reporter-san?
After all, I poured all my sizzli~ng feelings
for Trainer-chan into it☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho, I see...

I hurriedly explained things to the reporter
so her recent remark wouldn't be misunderstood—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, no way, no way~! Don't go turning
Maya's approach into a burnt crisp~!!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya is definitely, definitely
gonna get super close with Trainer-chan!
Right?♪

...What an unbelievable girl Mayano Top Gun was.
That said, business was business.
I still had to give an explanation to the press.
